notes: CONFORMS since kb/Work PB5379: ScreenSegmentNumber refuses a segment-number written with three or more digits (SEGMENT-LIMIT IS 010, IS 001) with COBOL6819, per §1985:III.2 'A segment-number may be expressed either as a one or two digit number'; SEGMENT-LIMIT IS 09 compiles. The format and SR1's value range were already implemented.

next.reason: 1985: "SEGMENT-LIMIT IS segment-number"; 2023: "No 2023 clause carries the Segmentation module or the SEGMENT-LIMIT clause; no candidate covers it.". No 2023 clause holds the Segmentation feature, and no candidate by wording covers SEGMENT-LIMIT, so the 2023 standard lacks the clause.
